children.text: The applicant should contact the District Office of the Horticulture Department.

applicationProcess.process_md: - The applicant should contact the District Office of the Horticulture Department.

basicDetails.schemeName: Special Scheme for Increasing the Storage Capacity of Perishable Products

children.text: The applicant must be a farmer.
The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.

children.text: Grant Assistance: A grant of 50% of the project cost up to a maximum of ₹2,00,00,000/- for cold storage facilities up to 5,000 metric tons capacity.

schemeContent.benefits_md: - Grant Assistance: A grant of 50% of the project cost up to a maximum of ₹2,00,00,000/- for cold storage facilities up to 5,000 metric tons capacity.
schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase the storage capacity of perishable products by providing grant assistance for cold storage facilities.

children.text: The scheme “Special Scheme for Increasing the Storage Capacity of Perishable Products” launched by the Horticulture and Food Processing Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to increase cold storage capacity through providing 50% grant assistance to all eligible farmers.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme “Special Scheme for Increasing the Storage Capacity of Perishable Products” launched by the Horticulture and Food Processing Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to increase cold storage capacity through providing 50% grant assistance to all eligible farmers.
